title: PM to Interact with Indian Contingent that Participated in Asian Para Games 2026 on 5 November
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will interact with the Indian contingent that participated in the Asian Para Games 2026 at around 4:30 PM on 5 November 2026 at Indira Gandhi Sports Complex, New Delhi. He will also address the gathering on the occasion. India registered its best-ever performance at the Asian Para Games held this year in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. A total of 97 Indian para-athletes won 114 medals, comprising 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals. The programme will be attended by the athletes, coaches, officials from the Paralympic Committee of India and the Indian Olympic Association, representatives of National Sports Federations, and officials from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. **** MJPS/SS/PRK
